Elena — appreciate the quick turnaround and attaching the COI. High level: we can start a conditional PO (PO stub) while we await a signed endorsement, provided the COI meets the minimum limits and Aurora agrees to issue the endorsement within our 30-day conditional window. To be explicit, procurement needs:

1) CGL: $1,000,000 each occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
2) Technology E&O / Cyber: $1,000,000
3) Certificate must name "Redwood Inference, Inc." as certificate holder (address optional)
4) Additional Insured endorsement on CGL naming Redwood Inference, Inc. — form CG 20 10 (or equivalent) preferred
5) Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood for GL if possible (not mandatory for activation but preferred)

If you can confirm (a) endorsement will be issued and (b) estimated ETA, we can generate PO stub Redwood_PO_Stub_6789.pdf and move to conditional activation — billing and SSO can be enabled while endorsement is in-flight.

Connor, can you queue the PO stub and mark it conditional on the endorsement? Marissa, looping you for intake tracking and to flag any risk exceptions.

Thanks,
